project: Q-DUET-VLM Phase 7D answer-evidence independence residual diagnostic

baseline.equivalence_test: The observer-only null adapter returns exact copies of agreement and corroboration matrices; fixed qore_answer, topk_answer, and qore_dpr controls receive no residual diagnostic output and therefore preserve their existing selector inputs.

core_invariants: Retrieval, data loading, gold answers, generation, QA metrics, selection, and reporting rules remain outside the diagnostic plugin boundary.

Residual coefficients are fit independently per question over candidate pairs using only answer confidence product, lexical duplication, and embedding redundancy; no gold labels or generated answers enter the fit.
Residual features are observation-only and are never passed to select_passages or a QUBO objective.
The collaborator output contains compact identifiers and numeric diagnostics only, with no raw questions, passages, answers, or predictions.
The full Wiki-DPR run remains collaborator-only.

interfaces.input_schema: agreement, corroboration, lexical duplication matrices; passage confidence vector; embedding redundancy matrix
interfaces.output_schema: validated raw target matrices and nuisance matrices

interfaces.input_schema: validated raw target matrices and nuisance matrices
interfaces.output_schema: standardized residual agreement/corroboration matrices plus compact fit diagnostics

plugins.insertion_point: after reader evidence and embedding construction, before fixed selection controls
plugins.hypothesis: The raw answer-evidence features can be observed without changing the established selector behavior.
plugins.input_schema: agreement, corroboration, duplication, confidence, and embedding redundancy
plugins.output_schema: exact validated copies of raw target and nuisance matrices
plugins.resource_estimate: O(N^2) validation and copy; no model pass

plugins.insertion_point: after answer_evidence_observer and before compact association analysis
plugins.hypothesis: Answer agreement or corroboration retains a useful F1 association after removing confidence, lexical duplication, and embedding redundancy explained variation.
plugins.input_schema: raw target matrices and selected nuisance matrices
plugins.output_schema: standardized per-question residual target matrices and ridge-fit diagnostics
plugins.resource_estimate: Four O(N^2) ridge fits per target and question; no additional reader pass
failure_signatures: residual association is near zero or reverses sign
residual association does not exceed raw association
positive result occurs for only one selector

composition.merge_rule: The observer is a null baseline transformer. independence_residual adds observation-only residual matrices; it cannot mutate the selector inputs.
interaction_ablations: fixed qore_answer versus topk_answer versus qore_dpr association

validation.baseline_equivalence: Observer-only fixtures return exact target matrices and the runner does not pass residual output to select_passages.

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation questions 150-199 with Wiki-DPR compressed retrieval
reproducibility.environment: record Python executable/version, git revision, plugin tree hash, reference generator path, dataset slice, K=5, seed=42, and bootstrap seed

limitations: This is a mechanism diagnostic, not a selector improvement or paper-level method claim.
Per-question linear residualization cannot prove causal independence and may miss nonlinear nuisance effects.
The pilot uses one generator, one K, and 50 held-out questions; a passing gate only authorizes a controlled follow-up.
Bootstrap intervals quantify association uncertainty but do not correct all exploratory multiplicity.
